blocks.label: Learning Phase
blocks.instructions:
Learning PhaseLearn to identify the two vessels from their acoustic signatures.
  • Feedback tells you correct or incorrect after each response
  • Pay attention — the correct vessel may change without warning

blocks.label: Noisy Signals
blocks.instructions:
Noisy SignalsNow signals have extra noise bands added — the vessel's true bands are still present.
  • Use all visible evidence
  • Feedback continues

blocks.label: Intermittent Signals
blocks.instructions:
Intermittent SignalsNow each frequency band only appears with 70% probability on each trial.
  • You may see only 3-4 bands — use the overall pattern
  • No feedback in this block
